name: K, OKT
description_md:
The K, OKT is a waymarked hiking route in HU that is part of the national waymarked hiking network. It is signposted as OKT and covers a distance of 1177.1 km.

The route involves 31404 m of ascent and 30843 m of descent. It takes about 377 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and is considered easy. The path passes Saint Martin Church in Hollókő within 100 m, Hollókő within 100 m, and Attila József House of Culture within 200 m.
